newsitem.title: INDIA: India IRFC to issue 2.5 bln rupee bonds on May 19.
newsitem.headline: India IRFC to issue 2.5 bln rupee bonds on May 19.

text.p: State-run Indian Railway Finance Corp (IRFC) will issue on May 19, 2.5 billion rupee bonds with a coupon rate of 14.25 percent and a tenor of seven years, a government statement said on Friday.
The bonds would be privately placed and issued with a put and call option after five years, it added.
The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) has awarded the bond issue the highest rating of "AAA".
Investment Information and Credit Rating Agency (ICRA) has also awarded it the highest rating of "LAAA", the statement said.
